description: pkix-profiles/Cargo.toml: x509-cert appears in [dependencies] but the only usage in pkix-profiles/src/lib.rs is inside #[cfg(test)] (line 189: 'use x509_cert::Certificate'). This means x509-cert is pulled in as a compile-time dependency for non-test builds, unnecessarily increasing the dependency footprint for users who only need the profile policy functions. It should be moved to [dev-dependencies]. This is a real dependency hygiene issue — users of pkix-profiles in no-test contexts carry the x509-cert transitive dep graph without needing it.
title: pkix-profiles: x509-cert is a runtime dep but only used in tests
